description: This file contains helper functions and constants for managing subagent runs, including session timing, orphan run resolution, and configuration-based behaviors within a subagent registry system.

methods.name: capFrozenResultText
methods.description: Trims and truncates a result text to a maximum byte size, appending a notice if truncated.

methods.name: resolveAnnounceRetryDelayMs
methods.description: Calculates exponential backoff delay for retry attempts, bounded by min and max delay constants.

methods.name: logAnnounceGiveUp
methods.description: Logs a warning when a subagent announce attempt is giving up, including retry count and elapsed time.

methods.name: resolveSubagentSessionStatus
methods.description: Determines the current status of a subagent session based on its record fields.

methods.name: getSubagentSessionStartedAt
methods.description: Retrieves the start time of a subagent session from its record.

methods.name: getSubagentSessionRuntimeMs
methods.description: Calculates the total runtime of a subagent session in milliseconds.

methods.name: persistSubagentSessionTiming
methods.description: Updates session store with timing and status info for a subagent run.

methods.name: resolveSubagentRunOrphanReason
methods.description: Determines if a subagent run is orphaned due to missing session entry or ID.

methods.name: safeRemoveAttachmentsDir
methods.description: Safely removes the attachments directory for a subagent run if conditions are met.

methods.name: reconcileOrphanedRun
methods.description: Marks a run as orphaned, updates its outcome, and optionally deletes attachments.

methods.name: reconcileOrphanedRestoredRuns
methods.description: Processes all runs to identify and reconcile orphaned runs.

methods.name: resolveArchiveAfterMs
methods.description: Calculates the delay in milliseconds after which a subagent's data should be archived based on config.
